name: event-calendar
title: Event calendar
about:
Adds events to your site: event lists and calendar views for the page builder, a details card with add-to-calendar links, calendar feeds visitors can subscribe to, and Event structured data for search engines.
Setup: installing creates the Calendar event, Venue, Organizer, Series and Category content types, so there is nothing to paste. An older event type from version 0.1 keeps working. Each event needs a start time, and only published events are used. Add the widgets you want in the page builder.
Widgets: Event details, a calendar with list, month, week, day, photo, summary and map views, a mini calendar, an event countdown, a featured venue and a map of venues. Events can repeat daily, weekly, monthly or yearly, and single dates can be skipped or changed. Venues, organizers and series get their own pages.
Maps use OpenStreetMap and are off by default. Turning them on looks up venue addresses and loads map tiles in the visitor's browser.
Visitors can send in events through a form. Submissions are off by default, are checked for spam, and the owner approves each one. You can also import an iCal URL by hand with Import now; imported events are staged for your review. There are no scheduled imports yet.
The time_zone setting defaults to UTC, so set it to your site's zone, for example Europe/London.
Limits: at most 100 events per import, no tickets or payments (only a ticket link), and the feed is cached for 15 minutes.
features: Calendar widget with list, month, week, day, photo, summary and map views
Event details card with Google, Outlook, Yahoo and iCal links
Recurring events with per-date skip and change
Mini calendar, countdown and featured venue widgets
Public event submissions, spam-checked and approved by the owner
Manual iCal import with Import now, staged for review
